facts.text: Endicott College was one of the first schools in the country to require three internships for every student, making internships an integrated, credit-earning graduation requirement rather than an optional add-on.

sources.title: Four-Year Internship Program | Endicott College
sources.quote: As one of the first schools in the country to require three internships for every student, Endicott's pioneering internship program transforms a rigorous liberal arts education into meaningful, real-world experience.

facts.text: Under Endicott's four-year internship program, students complete a first short-term internship of a minimum of 120 hours during their first year, a second short-term internship of a minimum of 120 hours during their second year, and a 14-week internship lasting 28-32 hours per week.

sources.title: Four-Year Internship Program | Endicott College
sources.quote: You will complete your first short-term internship during your first year, usually during the summer but some might be completed during the winter. These internships are a minimum of 120 hours, and you will earn two credits.

sources.title: Four-Year Internship Program | Endicott College
sources.quote: During the winter or summer, you'll complete the second short-term internship, lasting about three weeks or a minimum of 120 hours.

sources.title: Four-Year Internship Program | Endicott College
sources.quote: This internship lasts 14 weeks for 28-32 hours per week, and can be adjusted for students participating in co-ops, where they typically work for a longer period of time.
